mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.5% in a single month, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS rises >0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls >0.2pp MoM (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals reduced demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of slowing consumer spending and thus reduces the likelihood of aggressive central bank tightening, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY and HOUST declines (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO increases (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 3.0% signals a hawkish monetary policy shift that increases the risk of a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY and FEDFUNDS rises above 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% in a single month, it signals an overheating labor market that may trigger aggressive central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE falls below 3.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which increases the probability of an economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM and HOUST declines > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS and HOUST both decline by >0.5% MoM (t-test p-value > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.03.
